# media-preview-worker

Small service for media preview worker.

Operational entry: `src/worker.ts`. Paths are relative to the project root.

Repository: media-preview-worker. Continue inspecting files read-only. In that same chain, if the CLI object is {} while the studio profile remains unchanged, what count is returned?
Repository: media-preview-worker. Continue inspecting files read-only. Starting from turn two, also replace the profile argument with {}, keeping the env unchanged. What count is returned?
